stem.en: A ring-shaped object has uniform mass all the way around its circumference. Where is its centre of mass?
stem.et: Rõngakujulisel kehal on ühtlane mass kogu selle ümbermõõdu ulatuses. Kus asub selle masskese?

label.en: At the centre of the ring, in the empty space where there is no material at all
label.et: Rõnga keskel, tühjas ruumis, kus ei ole üldse materjali

label.en: Somewhere on the ring material itself, since mass must be present there
label.et: Kusagil rõnga materjalis endas, sest seal peab mass olemas olema

label.en: It has no well-defined centre of mass, since a ring has a hole in it
label.et: Sellel ei ole hästi määratud masskeset, sest rõngal on auk sees

label.en: At whichever point on the ring happens to be heaviest
label.et: Rõnga sellel punktil, mis juhtub olema kõige raskem
